name: Aid Locations during Civil Wars South of the Sahara
description: These data contain information on the spatial locations of foreign aid projects for countries south of the Sahara undergoing civil wars. The temporal range of the data spans from 1989-2008.
citation: Findley, Michael; Powell, Josh; Strandow, Daniel; Tanner, Jeff, 2012, "Aid Locations during Civil Wars South of the Sahara", https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/5WDATK, Harvard Dataverse, V1
